title: COMP5411 point-cloud evaluation protocol
scope: A reproducible experiment plan. This file contains no measured results and is not evidence that the experiment matrix has been run.

reproducibility.cameraTime: Use frameIndex / samplingFps, never wall-clock animation time.
reproducibility.selection: Use persistent source IDs and deterministic seed 20261010; reset selector state before every sequence.
reproducibility.noise: Gaussian displacement keyed to persistent source ID and seed 20261010; standard deviation is a fraction of original longest bounding-box extent. Recompute neighborhood features after noise.
reproducibility.runOrder: Deterministically shuffle configuration order with seed 20261010, repeat the same order within each paired reference/budget comparison.
reproducibility.reference: Render every source surfel with identical camera, radius policy, EDL setting, lighting, projection, and viewport. A full-point render is an internal renderer reference, not ground-truth reconstructed geometry.

datasetFamilies.featureProvenance: Analytical normals and designed feature proxies. Geometry and saliency proxies must not be presented as measured PCA curvature or validated perceptual saliency.

datasetFamilies.availability: implemented fixture generator; experiment runs planned

preprocess.largerCountRequirement: 32768-point fixture requires optional SciPy; NumPy fallback accepts at most 16000 points.

datasetFamilies.featureProvenance: Use computed neighborhood features; retain original source IDs for paired noise and selection comparisons.

datasetFamilies.availability: planned derived datasets; not generated or evaluated by this plan
datasetFamilies.source: Deterministic persistent-ID thinning of the neighborhood fixture
datasetFamilies.purpose: Check whether high-density flat regions suppress thin or sparse features under a fixed selection budget.

datasetFamilies.availability: planned external dataset; no scan bundled or evaluated by this plan
requirements: documented downsampling to the 100000-point interactive limit
datasetFamilies.purpose: Test generalization beyond designed synthetic feature proxies.

methods.description: Screen coverage, geometry, saliency and confidence allocation

budgets.rule: K = min(N, max(1, floor(ratio * N))). Use the identical K for all methods on the same source cloud and count every selected surfel against the budget.

camera.normalization: Application cameras use sceneScale = bounds.radius / 1.7, then add bounds.center to both eye and target. bounds.radius is half the bounding-box diagonal. Record this scale per cloud; Python preprocessing produces longest extent 1, so its radius and scale differ from the analytical demo scene.
camera.heldOutPolicy: Choose weights, stability settings, depth tolerance and display settings using development paths only. Freeze them before inspecting held-out outcomes.
camera.cutPolicy: Pass previousTime to cameraAt, reset selection history at a camera cut, and pass cut:true to temporalResidualMetric for the crossing pair. Report first-frame cut quality and post-cut recovery separately.

renderSettings.imageCapture: Capture RGBA after EDL whenever it is enabled; capture the matching raw depth buffer before postprocessing. Store arrays in gl.readPixels bottom-left row order.

sweeps.purpose: Isolate stabilization at identical budgets, camera samples, and image quality settings. Uniform selection remains deterministic and has no temporal state.

sweeps.pairedReference: Render the full density of the same noisy cloud, avoiding conflation of sampling error and geometric corruption.
sweeps.purpose: Measure whether confidence-aware allocation remains useful when neighborhood normals and local geometry are uncertain.

maeRgb.aggregation: All pixels and three RGB channels; alpha ignored.

foregroundHoleRate.aggregation: Reference foreground with budget background / reference foreground. Raw depth < 1 defines foreground.

depthCorrespondenceError.aggregation: Mean absolute depth difference at shared foreground pixels. Always report correspondence coverage alongside it; holes are measured separately.

temporalResidualRgb.definition: E_t = budgetRGBA_t - referenceRGBA_t. Mean absolute E_t - reproject(E_previous) across RGB channels.
temporalResidualRgb.reprojection: Unproject current reference pixel centers using raw depth and inverse current column-major view-projection; project into previous reference and sample nearest neighbor.
temporalResidualRgb.mask: Both-frame reference foreground, previous projection in bounds and in front, absolute raw-depth correspondence difference <= depthTolerance. Budget holes never exclude pixels.
temporalResidualRgb.emptyMask: Return null, never substitute zero; report validPixelCount and validPixelFraction.
temporalResidualRgb.limitation: Nearest-neighbor reprojection has subpixel sampling error; depth tolerance is camera-range-dependent and must be fixed and disclosed.

selectionTurnover.aggregation: 1 - |S_t intersect S_previous| / |S_t union S_previous| on persistent IDs; retain counts and exclude camera-cut crossings.

record: GPU render milliseconds when timer query supported
estimated allocated CPU and GPU bytes
performance.timing: Separate rendering from image readback, synchronous quality comparison, and file export. A CPU submission time is not GPU render time.
performance.gpuUnsupported: Report unavailable; do not substitute CPU timing as a GPU measurement.

reporting.sequenceSummary: Report image means per sequence and temporal mean weighted by valid correspondence counts. Retain per-frame values, null masks, worst image frames, and cut diagnostics.
reporting.comparison: Pair methods by dataset, budget, path, noise, EDL setting and seed. Show quality/performance tradeoffs; no superiority claims without measured support.
reporting.separateEvidence: Browser smoke checks and small validation sequences demonstrate implementation behavior only. They do not count as completion of this planned dataset/method/path matrix.
reporting.remainingWork: Generate and archive all planned datasets, acquire a licensed real scan, freeze development settings, execute the matrix, and analyze held-out results.
